decision: Make the phenotype-signal compression question the FIRST experiment; all downstream architecture work waits on it
Classify this package as DESIGN_ONLY_RUN_NOT_AUTHORIZED; it authorizes no execution and no Transformer or GPU work
Fix the compression objective as unsupervised reconstruction; the linear null is block PCA as the reconstruction optimum and NOT a supervised PLS
Reinstate the shared data contract; every arm sees byte-identical SNP set block version split folds and simulated traits
Measure fidelity by downstream retention on simulated traits never by reconstruction loss
Do not touch phenotype gating; it is Gate 2 and waits on 0A 0B and 1
Use a seed namespace disjoint from rc1 v6.1 and any v7 GPU/A1-R seed block
Relabel this experiment Gate 0A nonlinear compression headroom; it cannot decide the pretrained encoder or Grassmann
DELETE the rc1 Grassmann geometry-specificity kill; Gate 0A has no Grassmann arm; random bilinear is exploratory-only here and the matched comparator only at Gate 1
Record the gate ladder 0A 0B 1 2 so attribution is explicit; 0B 1 2 are neither designed nor authorized here
Primary decision metric is R2_genetic against the known genetic value g; R2_pheno is secondary; drop binary/AUC from round 1
Report total representation budget D_total = sum_b min(k,m_b) and compression ratio; the decision axis is total budget not per-block k
Run both MAF-standardized and raw-centered PCA; all p mean sd from outer-training folds only

Split between-block into additive (distributed polygenic) and interaction; interaction regimes use a matched degree-2 downstream identical across arms; a linear ridge cannot carry long-range interaction evidence
Freeze the six DGP regimes before any run; the spectral-tail adversarial regime is the primary decision regime
Inferential unit is the simulation replicate; paired delta with percentile bootstrap CI over replicates; not CV-fold CI
Primary cross-k summary is fixed budget points per-block k in {8,16}; all other k are exploratory to avoid selection bias
Apply the paired-mean criterion separately within each DGP regime; no pooled cross-regime average for the primary decision
Restore the two-dimensional judgement retention times cost; log bytes/sample memory encode and downstream time
Pre-run gates: fix centering AND standardization; bind hashes; run detectability gate to fix replicate count; run compute smoke or preregister eigensolver fallback; obtain run authorization
Fix the primary practical margin at Delta R2_genetic = 0.005 a priori; {0.002,0.010} are sensitivity only; the detectability gate fixes replicate count R never the margin
Primary interaction head is the explicit bilinear cross-product ridge on z_A (x) z_B (cross-block terms only excluding within-block quadratics); full degree-2 polynomial ridge is robustness only
Freeze seven DGP regimes in three tiers A primary-stress spectral_tail B additive-controls C interaction-stress; spectral_tail_adversarial is tier A and gates the verdict
Gate 0A verdict is three-way FAIL REGIME_DEPENDENT HEADROOM_SUPPORTED gated by spectral_tail; a positive cross-regime average never overrides a spectral_tail failure
Order is fixed: bind panel manifest hash then LD-block version hash then freeze/verify preprocessing (BINDING.json BOUND) BEFORE building or running the sigma pilot; never reversed
Hashes are computed from real server artifacts by bind_data_contract.py and never hand-typed or fabricated; if artifacts are unreachable the chain stops rather than binding an unverified contract
